hook: Forty years of UI rulebooks in one place

beats.say: Marcin Wichary has collected preserved UI style guides from companies starting in the early 1980s and continuing to today, with PDFs, mirrors and Wayback Machine links for each one.
It spans the Amiga Workbench, BlackBerry handhelds, Motif and CDE on Unix, and IBM's Common User Access, which influenced Windows and OS/2. The first Android guide he could locate dates from 2012.
You'll also find NeXTSTEP and OpenStep guidelines, Apple's Newton, and every edition of Material Design for Android.
